name: Slate Notes
description: Slate's notes in a small window of their own, installed and updated separately from Slate.
notes: Opens on your notes list with a big New note button, and a note with words but no title is kept as Untitled
Notes feel like Notion: toggles, a grouped / menu with previews, comments in the margin, an icon and cover on each note, and the bars hide while you type
Recently deleted has Delete for good on each note and an Empty button
The Add icon and Add cover row sits in the space above the title, so a short note no longer shows a scrollbar
